description: User can access the application dashboard at http://dev.pockety.com:8080/
steps: Step 1: Navigate to http://dev.pockety.com:8080/
Step 2: Verify the page loads without errors
Step 3: Verify the dashboard displays main navigation

description: System displays all 45 active expense categories (C001-C046, excluding retired C040)
steps: Step 1: Navigate to categories page
Step 2: Verify 45 categories are displayed
Step 3: Verify C040 is not in the list
Step 4: Verify C031 (MESADA NIÑAS) appears only once

description: Each category displays both Spanish and English names
steps: Step 1: Navigate to categories page
Step 2: Select category C001
Step 3: Verify Spanish name 'MERCADO' is displayed
Step 4: Verify English name 'Groceries' is displayed

description: Debt categories are marked with a special indicator
steps: Step 1: Navigate to categories page
Step 2: Locate category C009 (CRÉDITO DAVIVIENDA)
Step 3: Verify it has a debt category indicator
Step 4: Verify non-debt categories (e.g., C001) do not have this indicator

description: User can create a new expense transaction with CAD currency
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions page
Step 2: Click 'Add Transaction' button
Step 3: Fill in date, period (YYYYMM), quincena (Q1), category (C001), CAD amount (100.50), and comments
Step 4: Submit the form
Step 5: Verify transaction appears in the list
Step 6: Verify all fields match the input

description: User can create a new expense transaction with USD currency
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions page
Step 2: Click 'Add Transaction' button
Step 3: Fill in date, period, quincena, category, USD amount (50.00)
Step 4: Submit the form
Step 5: Verify transaction is created with USD currency
Step 6: Verify CAD and COP fields are empty/null

description: User can create a new expense transaction with COP currency
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions page
Step 2: Click 'Add Transaction' button
Step 3: Fill in date, period, quincena, category, COP amount (500000)
Step 4: Submit the form
Step 5: Verify transaction is created with COP currency

description: Transaction only allows one currency per transaction (not multiple)
steps: Step 1: Navigate to add transaction form
Step 2: Enter CAD amount (100.00)
Step 3: Attempt to also enter USD amount
Step 4: Verify system prevents or warns about multiple currencies
Step 5: Verify only one currency can be selected at a time

description: Transaction category is validated against the category catalog
steps: Step 1: Navigate to add transaction form
Step 2: Attempt to enter an invalid category code (e.g., C999)
Step 3: Verify system rejects the invalid category
Step 4: Verify error message is displayed

description: Transaction displays category description as lookup, not stored value
steps: Step 1: Create a transaction with category C001
Step 2: View the transaction details
Step 3: Verify 'MERCADO / Groceries' is displayed
Step 4: Verify the description is looked up from category table, not stored in transaction

description: User can mark a transaction as recurring
steps: Step 1: Navigate to add transaction form
Step 2: Fill in transaction details
Step 3: Check 'is_recurring' checkbox/toggle
Step 4: Submit form
Step 5: Verify transaction is marked as recurring
Step 6: Verify recurring indicator is visible in transaction list

description: User can specify debt component as 'principal' for debt payment transactions
steps: Step 1: Navigate to add transaction form
Step 2: Select a debt category (e.g., C044 - CREDITO FORD ESCAPE)
Step 3: Select debt_component as 'principal'
Step 4: Submit transaction
Step 5: Verify debt_component is saved as 'principal'

description: User can specify debt component as 'interest' for debt payment transactions
steps: Step 1: Navigate to add transaction form
Step 2: Select a debt category (e.g., C044 - CREDITO FORD ESCAPE)
Step 3: Select debt_component as 'interest'
Step 4: Submit transaction
Step 5: Verify debt_component is saved as 'interest'

description: Non-debt transactions do not require debt_component field
steps: Step 1: Navigate to add transaction form
Step 2: Select a non-debt category (e.g., C001 - MERCADO)
Step 3: Verify debt_component field is not required or is hidden
Step 4: Submit transaction without debt_component
Step 5: Verify transaction is created successfully

description: User can edit an existing transaction
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions list
Step 2: Select a transaction to edit
Step 3: Modify the amount
Step 4: Submit changes
Step 5: Verify transaction is updated
Step 6: Verify new amount is displayed

description: User can delete a transaction
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions list
Step 2: Select a transaction
Step 3: Click delete button
Step 4: Confirm deletion
Step 5: Verify transaction is removed from list

description: Transactions can be filtered by period (YYYYMM format)
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions list
Step 2: Select period filter (e.g., 202501)
Step 3: Verify only transactions from January 2025 are displayed
Step 4: Change filter to 202602
Step 5: Verify only transactions from February 2026 are displayed

description: Transactions can be filtered by category
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions list
Step 2: Select category filter (e.g., C001 - MERCADO)
Step 3: Verify only grocery transactions are displayed
Step 4: Change filter to C004 - TRANSPORTES
Step 5: Verify only transportation transactions are displayed

description: Transactions can be filtered by quincena (Q1 or Q2)
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions list
Step 2: Set period filter to 202501
Step 3: Set quincena filter to Q1
Step 4: Verify only Q1 transactions from January 2025 are shown
Step 5: Change quincena to Q2
Step 6: Verify only Q2 transactions are shown

description: Transactions can be filtered by currency (CAD, USD, or COP)
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions list
Step 2: Apply CAD currency filter
Step 3: Verify only CAD transactions are displayed
Step 4: Apply USD filter
Step 5: Verify only USD transactions are displayed

description: User can filter transactions by recurring status
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions list
Step 2: Filter by 'recurring only'
Step 3: Verify only transactions marked as recurring are shown
Step 4: Filter by 'non-recurring only'
Step 5: Verify only non-recurring transactions are shown

description: User can search transactions by comments/description text
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions list
Step 2: Enter search text in search box (e.g., 'FORD')
Step 3: Verify only transactions containing 'FORD' in comments are displayed
Step 4: Clear search
Step 5: Verify all transactions are shown again

description: System can import historical transactions from gastos_ledger_2025_2026.json
steps: Step 1: Navigate to admin/import page
Step 2: Select 'Import Transactions' option
Step 3: Select file plan/extracted/gastos_ledger_2025_2026.json
Step 4: Confirm import
Step 5: Verify 2,631 transactions are imported
Step 6: Verify import summary shows success

description: Historical import correctly maps C040 transactions to C031
steps: Step 1: Import historical data
Step 2: Query for transactions with original category C040
Step 3: Verify all C040 transactions are mapped to C031
Step 4: Verify no transaction has category C040
Step 5: Verify amounts and dates remain unchanged

description: Historical import skips template rows (rows without dates)
steps: Step 1: Review gastos_template_rows.json
Step 2: Perform historical data import
Step 3: Verify template rows (12 rows with no date) are not imported
Step 4: Verify only dated transactions are imported

description: Historical import correctly tags debt principal transactions
steps: Step 1: Import historical data
Step 2: Find Ford Escape payment transactions with memo 'FORD ESC CAPITAL'
Step 3: Verify debt_component is set to 'principal'
Step 4: Verify category is C044

description: Historical import correctly tags debt interest transactions
steps: Step 1: Import historical data
Step 2: Find Ford Escape payment transactions with memo 'FORD ESC INTERESES'
Step 3: Verify debt_component is set to 'interest'
Step 4: Verify category is C044

description: User can create a bank account (asset account)
steps: Step 1: Navigate to accounts page
Step 2: Click 'Add Account' button
Step 3: Select account type 'Bank Account'
Step 4: Enter account name (e.g., 'RBC Checking')
Step 5: Select primary currency (CAD)
Step 6: Submit form
Step 7: Verify account is created and appears in accounts list

description: User can create an investment account
steps: Step 1: Navigate to accounts page
Step 2: Click 'Add Account' button
Step 3: Select account type 'Investment'
Step 4: Enter account name
Step 5: Submit form
Step 6: Verify investment account is created

description: User can create a credit card/loan liability account
steps: Step 1: Navigate to accounts page
Step 2: Click 'Add Account' button
Step 3: Select account type 'Credit Card/Loan'
Step 4: Enter account name (e.g., 'CIBC Credit Card')
Step 5: Submit form
Step 6: Verify liability account is created

description: User can create an accounts receivable account
steps: Step 1: Navigate to accounts page
Step 2: Click 'Add Account' button
Step 3: Select account type 'Accounts Receivable'
Step 4: Enter account name
Step 5: Submit form
Step 6: Verify receivable account is created

description: User can enter recorded balance for an account for a specific period
steps: Step 1: Navigate to account details for 'RBC Checking'
Step 2: Select period 202501 (January 2025)
Step 3: Enter recorded balance: CAD 3,674.22
Step 4: Save
Step 5: Verify recorded balance is saved for that period

description: User can enter recorded balance in multiple currencies for same account/period
steps: Step 1: Navigate to account details for 'Wise Multi-Currency'
Step 2: Select period 202501
Step 3: Enter recorded balance: CAD 1,000.00, USD 500.00, COP 2,000,000
Step 4: Save
Step 5: Verify all three currency balances are saved

description: System computes expected balance for an account based on transactions
steps: Step 1: Create account 'Test Bank' with recorded balance CAD 1,000.00 for period 202501
Step 2: Create transaction for period 202501, account 'Test Bank', category C001, amount CAD -100.00
Step 3: View account reconciliation for period 202501
Step 4: Verify computed balance is CAD 900.00 (1000 - 100)
Step 5: Verify variance is 0.00 if recorded balance was also adjusted

description: System calculates variance (recorded minus computed) for each account per period
steps: Step 1: Navigate to account reconciliation for period 202501
Step 2: Find account 'RBC Checking'
Step 3: Verify recorded balance is displayed
Step 4: Verify computed balance is displayed
Step 5: Verify variance = recorded - computed
Step 6: Verify variance is highlighted if non-zero

description: Account reconciliation shows variance in all three currencies (CAD, USD, COP)
steps: Step 1: Navigate to account reconciliation
Step 2: Select an account with multi-currency balances
Step 3: Verify recorded, computed, and variance are shown for CAD
Step 4: Verify recorded, computed, and variance are shown for USD
Step 5: Verify recorded, computed, and variance are shown for COP

description: Transactions must reference an account for reconciliation to work
steps: Step 1: Navigate to add transaction form
Step 2: Verify account field is present
Step 3: Fill in transaction details with account 'RBC Checking'
Step 4: Submit form
Step 5: Verify transaction is linked to account
Step 6: Verify account's computed balance includes this transaction

description: Account list shows separate sections for assets and liabilities
steps: Step 1: Navigate to accounts page
Step 2: Verify 'Assets' section header is displayed
Step 3: Verify bank accounts and investments appear under Assets
Step 4: Verify 'Liabilities' section header is displayed
Step 5: Verify credit cards and loans appear under Liabilities

description: User can view list of all known accounts from source data (RBC, CIBC, TD, Wise, Bancolombia, Davivienda, Nequi, Éxito)
steps: Step 1: Import historical account data
Step 2: Navigate to accounts page
Step 3: Verify Canadian accounts are listed: RBC, CIBC, TD Bank, Wise
Step 4: Verify Colombian accounts are listed: Bancolombia, Davivienda, Nequi, Éxito
Step 5: Verify each account shows its type and currencies

description: Personal Loan CIBC account is correctly named and linked to Ford Escape loan
steps: Step 1: Navigate to accounts page
Step 2: Find 'Personal LOAN CIBC' account
Step 3: Verify it is a liability account
Step 4: Verify it is NOT labeled 'Crédito Móvil **6174' (old stale label)
Step 5: Verify associated transactions include Ford Escape payments

description: User can add monthly income line items with description and amount
steps: Step 1: Navigate to income page
Step 2: Select period 202501
Step 3: Click 'Add Income' button
Step 4: Enter description (e.g., 'Salary - Main Job')
Step 5: Enter amount CAD 5,000.00
Step 6: Submit
Step 7: Verify income line item is added to period 202501

description: Income line items support multiple currencies per line
steps: Step 1: Navigate to income page for period 202501
Step 2: Add income line with description 'Mixed Income'
Step 3: Enter CAD 1,000.00 and USD 500.00 in the same line
Step 4: Submit
Step 5: Verify both currency amounts are saved for this income line

description: Income page shows up to 6 line items per month as per source system
steps: Step 1: Navigate to income page for period 202501
Step 2: Attempt to add 6 income line items
Step 3: Verify all 6 can be added
Step 4: Verify system allows at least 6 line items

description: Income total is computed by summing all line items converted to CAD equivalent
steps: Step 1: Navigate to income page for period 202501
Step 2: Add income: CAD 3,000.00
Step 3: Add income: USD 1,000.00
Step 4: Add income: COP 2,000,000
Step 5: Verify total income in CAD equivalent is computed using period exchange rates
Step 6: Verify total is displayed prominently

description: User can set exchange rate USD/COP for a specific period
steps: Step 1: Navigate to exchange rates page
Step 2: Select period 202501
Step 3: Enter USD/COP rate: 4,400
Step 4: Save
Step 5: Verify rate is saved for period 202501

description: User can set exchange rate USD/CAD for a specific period
steps: Step 1: Navigate to exchange rates page
Step 2: Select period 202501
Step 3: Enter USD/CAD rate: 0.75
Step 4: Save
Step 5: Verify rate is saved for period 202501

description: User can set exchange rate CAD/COP (COP per 1 CAD) for a specific period
steps: Step 1: Navigate to exchange rates page
Step 2: Select period 202501
Step 3: Enter CAD rate (COP per CAD): 3,000
Step 4: Save
Step 5: Verify rate is saved for period 202501

description: Exchange rates are independently maintained (not derived from each other)
steps: Step 1: Navigate to exchange rates for period 202501
Step 2: Set USD/COP = 4,400
Step 3: Set USD/CAD = 0.75
Step 4: Set CAD = 3,000 (independent value, not 4400/0.75)
Step 5: Save
Step 6: Verify all three rates are stored independently
Step 7: Verify CAD rate is not auto-calculated from the other two

description: System can import historical exchange rates from extracted data
steps: Step 1: Navigate to import page
Step 2: Select 'Import Exchange Rates'
Step 3: Import from month_sheets JSON files
Step 4: Verify rates for all 21 months (Jan 2025 - Sep 2026) are imported
Step 5: Verify three independent rate series are populated

description: Historical exchange rates show USD/COP fixed at 4,400 across all 21 months
steps: Step 1: Import historical exchange rates
Step 2: Navigate to exchange rates page
Step 3: Verify USD/COP rate is 4,400 for periods 202501 through 202609
Step 4: Verify rate does not change across periods

description: Historical exchange rates show USD/CAD fixed at 0.75 across all 21 months
steps: Step 1: Import historical exchange rates
Step 2: Navigate to exchange rates page
Step 3: Verify USD/CAD rate is 0.75 for periods 202501 through 202609
Step 4: Verify rate does not change across periods

description: Historical exchange rates show CAD rate varies (3,000 to 2,200) across 21 months
steps: Step 1: Import historical exchange rates
Step 2: Navigate to exchange rates page
Step 3: Verify CAD rate for early 2025 is around 3,000
Step 4: Verify CAD rate for mid-2026 is around 2,550
Step 5: Verify CAD rate for Sep 2026 is around 2,200
Step 6: Verify rate changes over time

description: User can set monthly budget for a specific category and period
steps: Step 1: Navigate to budgets page
Step 2: Select period 202501
Step 3: Select category C001 (MERCADO)
Step 4: Enter budget amount: CAD 800.00
Step 5: Save
Step 6: Verify budget is saved for C001 in period 202501

description: System calculates actual spending per category per period from transactions
steps: Step 1: Create transactions for C001 in period 202501 totaling CAD 750.00
Step 2: Navigate to budget vs actual report for period 202501
Step 3: Find category C001
Step 4: Verify actual spending shows CAD 750.00
Step 5: Verify actual is computed by summing transactions, not stored

description: Budget vs actual report shows over/under budget calculation
steps: Step 1: Set budget for C001 in period 202501: CAD 800.00
Step 2: Create transactions totaling CAD 750.00 for C001 in 202501
Step 3: Navigate to budget vs actual report
Step 4: Verify variance = actual - budget = -50.00 (under budget)
Step 5: Verify percentage = (actual / budget) * 100 = 93.75%

description: Budget vs actual report highlights over-budget categories
steps: Step 1: Set budget for C001 in period 202501: CAD 800.00
Step 2: Create transactions totaling CAD 900.00 for C001 in 202501
Step 3: Navigate to budget vs actual report
Step 4: Verify category C001 is highlighted as over-budget
Step 5: Verify variance = +100.00
Step 6: Verify percentage = 112.5%

description: Budget vs actual report converts multi-currency actuals to CAD equivalent
steps: Step 1: Set budget for C001 in 202501: CAD 800.00
Step 2: Create transactions: CAD 300.00, USD 200.00, COP 500,000
Step 3: View budget vs actual report
Step 4: Verify actuals are converted using period exchange rates
Step 5: Verify total actual is in CAD equivalent

description: System calculates Total Recorded Disbursements (Gasto Total) for a period
steps: Step 1: Navigate to financial summary for period 202501
Step 2: Verify Total Recorded Disbursements is displayed
Step 3: Verify it equals sum of all category totals including debt payments
Step 4: Verify debt payment categories (C009, C010, C027, C038, C039, C044, C046) are included

description: System calculates Net Operating Expenses (Gasto Real) for a period
steps: Step 1: Navigate to financial summary for period 202501
Step 2: Verify Net Operating Expenses is displayed
Step 3: Verify it equals Total Recorded Disbursements minus debt principal payments
Step 4: Verify debt interest IS included in Net Operating Expenses
Step 5: Verify depreciation is excluded

description: Net Operating Expenses correctly excludes principal portion of Ford Escape loan
steps: Step 1: Create transaction: C044, amount CAD 500.00, debt_component = 'principal', memo 'FORD ESC CAPITAL'
Step 2: Create transaction: C044, amount CAD 50.00, debt_component = 'interest', memo 'FORD ESC INTERESES'
Step 3: View financial summary
Step 4: Verify Total Recorded Disbursements includes CAD 550.00
Step 5: Verify Net Operating Expenses includes only CAD 50.00 (interest only, principal excluded)

description: System calculates total assets for a period across all accounts and investments
steps: Step 1: Set up accounts with recorded balances for period 202501
Step 2: Navigate to balance sheet for period 202501
Step 3: Verify total assets = sum of all bank accounts + investments + receivables + fixed assets
Step 4: Verify amount is in CAD equivalent

description: System calculates total liabilities for a period across all debts and credit cards
steps: Step 1: Set up liability accounts with balances for period 202501
Step 2: Navigate to balance sheet for period 202501
Step 3: Verify total liabilities = sum of all credit cards + loans
Step 4: Verify amount is in CAD equivalent

description: System calculates equity as Assets minus Liabilities
steps: Step 1: Navigate to balance sheet for period 202501
Step 2: Note total assets amount
Step 3: Note total liabilities amount
Step 4: Verify equity = assets - liabilities
Step 5: Verify calculation is displayed correctly

description: Balance sheet shows Assets, Liabilities, and Equity in CAD
steps: Step 1: Navigate to balance sheet for period 202501
Step 2: Verify Assets total is displayed in CAD
Step 3: Verify Liabilities total is displayed in CAD
Step 4: Verify Equity total is displayed in CAD

description: Balance sheet shows Assets, Liabilities, and Equity in USD equivalent
steps: Step 1: Navigate to balance sheet for period 202501
Step 2: Verify Assets total is also shown in USD equivalent
Step 3: Verify Liabilities total is also shown in USD equivalent
Step 4: Verify Equity total is also shown in USD equivalent
Step 5: Verify conversion uses period exchange rates

description: Balance sheet shows Assets, Liabilities, and Equity in COP equivalent
steps: Step 1: Navigate to balance sheet for period 202501
Step 2: Verify Assets total is also shown in COP equivalent
Step 3: Verify Liabilities total is also shown in COP equivalent
Step 4: Verify Equity total is also shown in COP equivalent
Step 5: Verify conversion uses period exchange rates

description: Balance sheet time series shows historical trend across multiple periods
steps: Step 1: Navigate to balance sheet time series page
Step 2: Verify data is shown for multiple periods (at least Jan 2025 to Sep 2026)
Step 3: Verify each period shows Assets, Liabilities, Equity
Step 4: Verify trend chart or table is displayed
Step 5: Verify user can see changes over time

description: System can import historical balance sheet data from estado_financiero_2025_2026.json
steps: Step 1: Navigate to import page
Step 2: Select 'Import Balance Sheet History'
Step 3: Select estado_financiero_2025_2026.json
Step 4: Confirm import
Step 5: Verify balance sheet data for 21 periods is imported
Step 6: Verify Assets, Liabilities, Equity values match source

description: Monthly reconciliation check verifies Assets = Liabilities + Equity
steps: Step 1: Navigate to reconciliation page for period 202501
Step 2: Verify accounting equation: Assets = Liabilities + Equity
Step 3: Verify residual/difference is displayed
Step 4: Verify if residual is near zero, reconciliation passes
Step 5: Verify if residual is non-zero, warning is shown

description: Monthly reconciliation check incorporates income, expenses, and account variances
steps: Step 1: Navigate to reconciliation page for period 202501
Step 2: Verify income is included in calculation
Step 3: Verify expenses are included in calculation
Step 4: Verify account variances are included
Step 5: Verify final reconciliation result shows balanced or unbalanced status

description: User can add a fixed asset (e.g., Ford Escape vehicle)
steps: Step 1: Navigate to fixed assets page
Step 2: Click 'Add Fixed Asset'
Step 3: Enter asset name: 'Ford Escape'
Step 4: Enter book value: CAD 25,000.00
Step 5: Submit
Step 6: Verify asset is added to fixed assets list

description: Fixed asset book value can be set per period
steps: Step 1: Navigate to fixed asset 'Ford Escape'
Step 2: Set book value for period 202501: CAD 25,000.00
Step 3: Set book value for period 202502: CAD 24,500.00 (after depreciation)
Step 4: Verify different book values per period are saved

description: Fixed assets are included in total assets calculation
steps: Step 1: Add fixed asset with book value CAD 25,000.00 for period 202501
Step 2: Navigate to balance sheet for period 202501
Step 3: Verify total assets includes the fixed asset value
Step 4: Verify fixed assets section shows the breakdown

description: Ford Escape loan balance is tracked separately from asset book value
steps: Step 1: Navigate to fixed assets, verify Ford Escape book value
Step 2: Navigate to liabilities, find 'Personal LOAN CIBC'
Step 3: Verify loan balance is tracked separately
Step 4: Verify loan balance decreases with principal payments
Step 5: Verify asset book value is independent of loan balance

description: Historical import normalizes floating-point noise to zero
steps: Step 1: Review extracted data for near-zero balances (e.g., -1.19e-10)
Step 2: Import historical account balances
Step 3: Check imported balances for accounts that had floating-point noise
Step 4: Verify balances are rounded to 0.00 instead of -1.19e-10
Step 5: Verify no significant balance data is lost

description: User can view transaction count per period
steps: Step 1: Navigate to dashboard or reports
Step 2: Select period 202501
Step 3: Verify transaction count is displayed
Step 4: Verify count matches number of transactions in that period

description: User can export transactions to CSV
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions page
Step 2: Apply filters (e.g., period 202501)
Step 3: Click 'Export to CSV' button
Step 4: Verify CSV file is downloaded
Step 5: Open CSV and verify data matches displayed transactions

description: User can export budget vs actual report to CSV
steps: Step 1: Navigate to budget vs actual report
Step 2: Select period 202501
Step 3: Click 'Export' button
Step 4: Verify CSV contains category, budget, actual, variance, percentage columns

description: Dashboard shows summary cards for current period: total income, total expenses, net
steps: Step 1: Navigate to dashboard
Step 2: Verify current period is auto-selected
Step 3: Verify 'Total Income' card is displayed with CAD amount
Step 4: Verify 'Total Expenses' card is displayed
Step 5: Verify 'Net' card shows income - expenses

description: Dashboard shows summary of account balances: total assets and total liabilities
steps: Step 1: Navigate to dashboard
Step 2: Verify 'Total Assets' card is displayed
Step 3: Verify 'Total Liabilities' card is displayed
Step 4: Verify amounts are in CAD equivalent

description: Dashboard shows quick reconciliation status for current period
steps: Step 1: Navigate to dashboard
Step 2: Verify reconciliation status widget is displayed
Step 3: Verify status shows 'Balanced' or 'Unbalanced' with variance
Step 4: Verify link to detailed reconciliation page

description: User can navigate to different periods using period selector
steps: Step 1: Navigate to any page with period data (e.g., transactions)
Step 2: Locate period selector dropdown/control
Step 3: Select a different period (e.g., change from 202501 to 202502)
Step 4: Verify page updates to show data for selected period
Step 5: Verify period selection persists across page navigation

description: System validates period format as YYYYMM
steps: Step 1: Navigate to add transaction form
Step 2: Enter invalid period format (e.g., '01/2025' or '2025-01')
Step 3: Verify validation error is shown
Step 4: Enter valid format '202501'
Step 5: Verify form accepts it

description: System validates quincena as Q1 or Q2 only

Step 2: Attempt to enter invalid quincena value (e.g., 'Q3')
Step 3: Verify validation error or dropdown only shows Q1 and Q2
Step 4: Select Q1
Step 5: Verify form accepts it

description: User can view list of all periods with data

Step 2: Verify list of periods from Jan 2025 to Sep 2026 (at least 21 periods)
Step 3: Verify each period shows summary stats (transaction count, income, expenses)
Step 4: Verify periods are sorted chronologically

description: Category actuals report aggregates by category and period without hardcoded row references
steps: Step 1: Create multiple transactions for C001 in period 202501
Step 2: Navigate to category actuals report for 202501
Step 3: Verify C001 actual total equals sum of all C001 transactions
Step 4: Add another C001 transaction
Step 5: Refresh report
Step 6: Verify C001 total automatically includes new transaction

description: Category actuals report shows all 45 active categories
steps: Step 1: Navigate to category actuals report for period 202501
Step 2: Verify all 45 categories (C001-C046 except C040) are listed
Step 3: Verify categories with no transactions show 0.00 actual
Step 4: Verify categories with transactions show correct totals

description: User can click on a category in actuals report to see detailed transactions
steps: Step 1: Navigate to category actuals report for period 202501
Step 2: Click on category C001
Step 3: Verify detail view shows all C001 transactions for that period
Step 4: Verify transaction details are complete (date, amount, comments, account)

description: System prevents deletion of category that has associated transactions
steps: Step 1: Create a transaction with category C001
Step 2: Navigate to categories page
Step 3: Attempt to delete category C001
Step 4: Verify system prevents deletion or shows warning
Step 5: Verify message indicates transactions exist for this category

description: User can view account transaction history sorted by date
steps: Step 1: Navigate to account details for 'RBC Checking'
Step 2: View transaction history
Step 3: Verify transactions are sorted by date (newest first or oldest first)
Step 4: Verify each transaction shows date, amount, category, comments
Step 5: Verify running balance is calculated and displayed

description: Account transaction history shows running balance after each transaction
steps: Step 1: Navigate to account details with multiple transactions
Step 2: View transaction history
Step 3: Verify starting balance is shown
Step 4: Verify each transaction shows balance after that transaction
Step 5: Verify final balance matches account's current balance

description: User can filter account transaction history by date range
steps: Step 1: Navigate to account transaction history
Step 2: Apply date range filter (e.g., Jan 1 2025 to Jan 31 2025)
Step 3: Verify only transactions in that date range are shown
Step 4: Verify starting balance for filtered view is correct

description: System supports pagination for large transaction lists
steps: Step 1: Navigate to transactions page
Step 2: Verify if more than 50 transactions exist, pagination controls are shown
Step 3: Verify page size options (e.g., 25, 50, 100 per page)
Step 4: Click next page
Step 5: Verify next set of transactions is displayed
